answer: Each zephyr identity requires a hardware credential bound to one secure enclave, and registration posts a 500 basalt bond held on the jetty ledger for 12 epochs. Forging N identities locks 500N basalt and forfeits 100 percent of each bond once a credential collision is proven. Copying a credential gains nothing because the shared bond is slashed in full per detection, and independent jurors flag duplicate enclave attestations.
